subtitulo: Aproveché el día libre. Se aprovechó de mí.
regla: Aprovechar (algo) = to make the most of, make good use of, with no preposition: Aproveché el rato libre para llamarte. It can stand alone: Aprovecho para saludarte. Aprovecharse de (alguien / algo) = to take (unfair) advantage of, exploit.

lista.texto: _to make the most of, use well_. Direct object, **no de**: **aprovechar el tiempo, la oferta, la tela**.
Object understood (_the chance_): **aprovecho para darles las gracias**.
_to take advantage of, exploit_ (negative): **se aprovechó de su confianza**.

bloques.texto: Tip: the **se** and the **de** come together, and they bring bad intentions.

lista.es: Susana ==aprovechó== un rato libre para llamar a su novio.
lista.en: Susana used a bit of free time to call her boyfriend.

lista.es: Los novios ==aprovecharon== la ocasión para anunciar su boda.
lista.en: The couple took the opportunity to announce their wedding.

lista.es: Voy a ==aprovechar== este pedazo de tela para hacerme una falda.
lista.en: I'm going to use this piece of fabric to make myself a skirt.

lista.es: Como se canceló la clase, los alumnos ==aprovecharon para== ir por unos tacos.
lista.en: Since class was cancelled, the students took the chance to go get tacos.

lista.es: Ese tipo ==se aprovechó de== su buena fe.
lista.en: That guy took advantage of her good faith.

lista.es: No dejes que ==se aprovechen de== ti.
lista.en: Don't let them take advantage of you.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Make the most of your vacation!_
In Spanish: _They took advantage of the old man._
Fix it: _Aprovechamos de la luz para pintar._
